component.name: Lente
component.summary: Settings for Elgato Facecam and UVC webcams on Linux
Ajustes de cámaras web Elgato Facecam y UVC en Linux

description.p: Lente controls your webcam on Linux: live preview with resolution and frame rate, framing, exposure, focus, white balance, picture, HDR and noise reduction. With Elgato Facecam cameras it also offers the camera's own settings (tint, vibrancy, locks, low-light mode, status light, saving to the camera) and applies the profile the camera stored from Windows.
Independent project, not affiliated with Elgato or Corsair.
Saving inside the camera with a check; the original's write spacing, frame transitions, focus presets and status light; tarball, .deb, .rpm, AppImage and Flatpak packages and a terminal installer.
14 languages, millisecond start-up, full screen, grid, focus presets and smooth transitions.
Factory reset like the original; fps reported by the camera.
Frame rates, two-thread capture, Windows profile, direct USB access, Flatpak and AppImage packages.
